Gantry jog

Connect both boards, then press an arrow key or hold an on-screen arrow. Hold arrows to accelerate; combine X and Y arrows to move diagonally. Release either arrow to slow that axis. Opposite arrows cancel on the same axis.

Joystick

Drag and hold to move X/Y together. Distance from center controls speed up to the target above. Release to decelerate.

Use the left stick. Center it while holding button 1 (A / Cross), then move. Release the button to decelerate.

X/Y soft limits

Set minimum and maximum commanded positions in full steps. Stop both axes, then apply each axis. Firmware enforces the limits, including queued pulses; homed bounds remain in effect. Limits must contain the current position. Custom limits reset on board restart or homing; check the active range after reconnecting.

GOTO prepares both axes, starts them together, and scales their speeds to arrive together. The longer axis uses your target speed; both use fixed 400 ms ramps. Short moves may finish before reaching that speed. Positions use commanded steps from this power-on session; they do not measure the gantry or track manual movement. Save only while stopped. Board restarts invalidate saved positions.

Motion details

Homing and custom soft limits use commanded position, not shaft feedback. Rehome after manual movement or missed steps. Direction depends on wiring; physical distance is uncalibrated. Focus loss, connection loss and faults stop immediately. Coils release when stopped. Half stepping alternates one and two energized coils and can generate more heat.

Connect two different boards with updated responsive jog firmware. Arrow controls are available as soon as both boards are connected and healthy.
